lines: Ae abr-e-karam, tham tham ke baras
couplets.en: Gentle cloud, let your rain fall softly.

lines: Itna na baras ke woh aa na sake
couplets.en: Do not rain so hard that my love cannot come.

lines: Woh aa jaaye to jam ke baras
couplets.en: Once my love arrives, let the rain come down.

lines: Itna baras ke woh ja na sake
couplets.en: Let it rain enough to keep my love here.

lines: Is qadar tera tasavvur kabhi badh jaata hai
couplets.en: Sometimes the thought of you grows so vivid.

lines: Aaina dekhun to munh tera nazar aata hai
couplets.en: I look in the mirror and see your face.

lines: Teri surat nigahon mein phirti rahe
couplets.en: Your face keeps passing before my eyes.

lines: Ishq tera sataaye to main kya karun?
couplets.en: What can I do when loving you gives me no peace?

lines: Koi itna to aa kar bata de hamein

lines: Jab teri yaad aaye to main kya karun?
